items.text: UNWHOLESOME MOLD AND FUNGI COVER THE DECAYING RUINS OF THE KEEP'S STABLE. A PUTRID SMELL OF SICKNESS RISES AS YOU ENTER THE BUILDING.
items.direction: disgusted, ominous fantasy narration; vivid but controlled

items.text: A THICK CARPET OF FUNGUS COVERS THE FLOOR OF THIS ROOM.
A BROKEN HEARTH AND BELLOWS DOMINATES THE COLLAPSED REMAINS OF A BLACKSMITH'S SHOP. THE FLOOR IS SPONGEY AND DAMP. THE CROAKING OF FROGS GREETS YOUR ENTRY.
items.direction: atmospheric fantasy narration; build quiet unease toward the croaking
perform a single abrupt, unnatural frog-like croak in the narrator's voice

items.text: AS YOU SEARCH THROUGH THE WRECKED SMITHY, YOU FIND THAT TIME HAS CRUMBLED EVERYTHING WITH THE EXCEPTION OF ONE OLD HAMMER. DO YOU TAKE IT?
items.direction: measured fantasy narration with mild discovery; finish with a clear direct question

items.text: THIS BUILDING IS FILLED WITH BROKEN AND SPLINTERED WOOD, THE REMAINS OF THE BUNKS AND CHESTS OF THE ORIGINAL DEFENDERS. IT SEEMS EVERYTHING HAS BEEN WELL LOOTED.
